absorb.title_zh: RM0008 Rev 21 独立看门狗的 1 秒与窗口看门狗
absorb.title_en: RM0008 Rev 21 independent-watchdog second and the window watchdog
absorb.snapshot: RM0008 Rev 21, February 2021, chapters 17 and 18. IWDG: T = prescaler / f_LSI × (Reload + 1). Prescaler 64 and f_LSI taken as 40 kHz give a 625 Hz count. Reload 624 is 1 second.
